mainEntity.name: What are common issues to watch for after new kitchen plumbing installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a new kitchen plumbing installation, it's advisable to watch for common issues such as leaks around fixture connections, slow drainage, or unusual noises coming from pipes. Even with professional installation, minor adjustments may sometimes be needed. If you notice any issues, contact your installer promptly. Frasheski Construction conducts thorough testing before project completion to minimize these occurrences, but we also offer follow-up support to address any concerns in our service areas like Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito.
